brief.brief: Show how a project's net present value falls as the discount rate rises, and that the rate where it reaches zero is the internal rate of return.
brief.misconception: Thinks a higher discount rate makes a project more valuable.
brief.numbers: Illustrative: I_0 = 1000, CF = 400 per year for 3 years, r from 0 to 20 %.

brief.brief: Compare two projects with the same cost, one paying early and one paying late, and show the crossover rate where their ranking flips.
brief.numbers: Illustrative: both cost 1000; early pays 600, 500, 100; late pays 100, 400, 800.

brief.brief: Zeige, dass der Preis einer Anleihe sinkt, wenn die Rendite steigt, und dass lange Laufzeiten stärker reagieren.
brief.notation: P = sum_t C / (1 + y)^t + N / (1 + y)^T
brief.numbers: Illustrativ: Nennwert 100, Kupon 4 %, Laufzeiten 2 und 10 Jahre, Rendite 0 bis 10 %.

brief.brief: Show how the outstanding balance of an annuity loan falls slowly at first and faster later, because the interest share of each payment shrinks.
Show where supply and demand meet, and how a rise in demand moves price and quantity.
brief.misconception: Thinks a higher price always lowers the quantity sold, even when demand shifts.
brief.numbers: Illustrative linear curves: demand p = 100 - q, supply p = 20 + 0.5 q.

brief.brief: Zeige Umsatz und Gesamtkosten über der Menge und den Break-even-Punkt, an dem der Gewinn null ist.
brief.notation: U = p * x, K = K_f + k_v * x

brief.brief: Split an end balance into principal, simple interest and interest on interest, and show that interest on interest grows faster over longer horizons.
Show how the cost of equity and the after-tax cost of debt add up to the WACC, weighted by their shares.
brief.notation: WACC = E/V * r_E + D/V * r_D * (1 - t)

brief.brief: Zerlege die Rendite einer USD-Anlage für einen CHF-Investor in Lokalrendite und Währungseffekt, auch wenn der Währungseffekt negativ ist.
Show GDP as consumption, investment, government spending and net exports, with net exports possibly negative.
Zeige, wie vom Umsatz Warenaufwand, Personalaufwand, Abschreibungen, Zinsen und Steuern abgehen, bis der Reingewinn bleibt.
Show each asset's contribution to a portfolio's return as weight times return.
brief.numbers: Illustrative: stocks 60 % at 8 %, bonds 30 % at 3 %, cash 10 % at 1 %.

brief.topic: How a bank loan creates a deposit
brief.brief: Show the bank's and the borrower's balance sheets as a loan is granted and the money is spent.
brief.misconception: Thinks banks lend out existing deposits.

brief.brief: Zeige die Bilanz einer Firma bei einer Kapitalerhöhung gegen Bargeld und danach beim Kauf einer Maschine.
brief.numbers: Illustrativ: 1 Mio. CHF neue Aktien, Maschine 600 000.

brief.brief: Show the central bank's and a commercial bank's balance sheets when the commercial bank borrows reserves in a repo against securities, and when it repays.
Zeige, wie die Abschreibung einer Maschine den Buchwert und das Eigenkapital über drei Jahre senkt.
brief.numbers: Illustrativ: Maschine 30 000, lineare Abschreibung über 3 Jahre.

brief.brief: Show how a policy rate rise reaches inflation through lending, the exchange rate and expectations.
brief.misconception: Thinks a rate rise lowers inflation immediately.
brief.notation: Use the course terms: policy rate, lending rates, demand, exchange rate, expectations, inflation.

brief.brief: Zeige, wie ein Ölpreisanstieg über Treibstoff, Transportkosten und Löhne die Konsumentenpreise erreicht, und dass ein Rückgang umgekehrt wirkt.
Zeige die Wirkung einer Frankenaufwertung auf Exporte, Importpreise, Tourismus und Inflation in der Schweiz.
Show how extra government spending raises income, consumption and again income, and how higher interest rates can crowd out investment.
Show that a currency forward offsets the currency loss on a foreign investment, so the hedged return is close to the local return minus the hedge cost.
brief.numbers: Illustrative: local return 5 %, currency falls 6 %, hedge cost 1 %.

brief.brief: Show that a bond's price change for a yield change is roughly duration times the change, and that the curve bends (convexity).
Zeige, wie eine Mengensteuer die Angebotskurve verschiebt und wer die Steuer trägt, je nach Steigung von Angebot und Nachfrage.
brief.numbers: Illustrativ: Nachfrage p = 120 - q, Angebot p = 20 + q, Steuer 10 pro Einheit.

brief.brief: Split a nominal return into the real return and inflation, and show that the real return can be negative.
